backlog.description: Add Cache-Control: immutable for Vite content-hashed assets in /assets/; no-cache for index.html
Add indexes on books.title and books.created_at for ORDER BY performance
SQLite FTS5 for full-text book search - already implemented (migration 20260412000000_add_books_fts.sql)
Go benchmarks for DB query functions - already exists in internal/db/bench_test.go
Add index on book_downloads.book_file_id for cascade delete efficiency
Add composite index on reading_progress(user_id, updated_at) to eliminate filesort for ListReadingProgress ORDER BY updated_at DESC
backlog.note: New dashboard feature (PR #1799) queries reading_progress with ORDER BY updated_at DESC; single-column user_id index requires a filesort. Composite index eliminates this.

backlog.description: HandleReadingProgressStats calls both GetReadingStats (COUNT aggregate) and ListReadingProgress (all rows). TotalTracked=len(progressList) and TotalFinished can be derived from the slice, saving one DB query per dashboard load.
backlog.note: Greptile also flagged this on PR #1799. Code change in internal/handlers/reading_progress.go. Medium complexity.
